notes:
- Fixed security issues: open CORS + unrestricted local file read, and a shell command injection in the open-folder action
- Fixed crashes: missing error handlers and double-response bugs that could take down the whole backend
- Fixed a hang in local Whisper transcription and added a timeout to text-to-speech generation
- Fixed rendering: hardware encoder detection now verifies the encoder actually works instead of trusting what ffmpeg was compiled with, which was breaking every render on non-NVIDIA machines
- Fixed hardware specs, drive space, cache size, presets, and VoxCPM2 status, which were previously fake/hardcoded
- Fixed several memory/resource leaks in the UI and render queue
